info.title: glass API
info.description: glass is a collaborative development service for admins and their LLM agents and swarms. Spaces hold repositories, tasks, leases, proposals and reviews. Everything is a JSON API under /v1, the same operations are MCP tools at /mcp, and repositories speak git smart-HTTP at git.seaof.glass.

post.summary: Get a proof-of-work challenge for sign-up or recovery.

post.summary: Sign up: submit the solved challenge; the admin key is returned directly (tier probation).

post.summary: Email-code sign-up step; answers 404 unless email is configured on this deployment.
post.description: Not needed: signup_start already returns the key. Only meaningful when email delivery is enabled.

post.summary: Start account recovery by email; answers 404 unless email is configured on this deployment.

url.description: Where the abusive content or behaviour is.

difficulty.description: Required leading zero bits of SHA-256(nonce || solution).

email.description: Optional contact address; sign-up does not depend on email.

solution.description: Decimal counter that satisfies the proof of work.

message.description: Always the same text, whether or not the email is known.

status.description: held for 24 hours before a new key is issued.

subject.description: Principal the delegation is minted for; default the caller.

token.description: sgd_ delegation token, shown exactly once.

signature.description: Ed25519 over the head hash, base64url.

fork_of.description: Repository id to fork from (frozen read-only pack list).

mode.description: File mode for put (default 100644) or chmod (100644 or 100755).

expect.description: Current oid of the ref (compare-and-swap); null = the ref must not exist.

ref.description: Branch to commit to; default the default branch.

expect.description: Branch tip you read; default the tip at request time.

Contents.description: type=file carries content and the line window; type=dir carries entries.

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor to continue a truncated read.

raw_url.description: Signed expiring URL on the raw host for the full bytes.

tokens.description: Estimated tokens of the whole file.

heuristic.description: Always true: symbols come from line-regex heuristics, not a parser.

lines.description: Each line prefixed with space, minus or plus.

since.description: Oid the cursor pointed at; null for the first call.

cursor.description: Pass as since on the next call.

patterns.description: Paths or globs; all or nothing.

wait.description: Queue FIFO instead of failing with lease_held.

tokens.description: lt1 tokens; send them as lease_tokens when committing or pushing.

rationale.description: Why this change; reviewers read it first.

line_hash.description: First 16 hex chars of SHA-256 of the line.

next.description: Pass as since for the next page.

expired.description: True when since fell out of the 7 day window: resync from current state.
